visual.description: Full QuadrantScatter at 100% — all 34 dots visible, hero shot. Brief hold 2-3s. Then slow zoom toward USA-Germany gap. Connector line: '$45.82/hr vs $51.82/hr — 470 hours apart.' Then view pulls back to show USA, Germany, and Greece as a triangle. Three dots pulse. Then all dots fade except these three. Denmark briefly flashes for 'takes home nearly as much' callback. Final text: 'What is an hour of your life worth?' fades in. Slow fade to #1A1B22 black. Channel watermark. Hold 5s silence for YouTube end screen.

textOverlay.finalQuestion: What is an hour of your life worth?

notes: Closing: hero shot → USA-DEU connector → expand to USA-DEU-GRC triangle → Denmark flash callback → philosophical question → fade to black. The zoom targets the midpoint between USA and Germany. Triangle is the visual summary of the entire video — DREAM, GRIND, TRAP. 'What is an hour of your life worth?' in Inter, subtle fade. YouTube end screen elements in last 20s. No 'like and subscribe' — silence is the CTA.
